inputs.text:
A vertical overhead phone selfie of a 24-year-old adult woman wearing an opaque fitted red long-sleeved athletic top zipped to a high collar and black fitted shorts. The red fabric follows a large rounded bust, tapers inward at a narrow waist and widens over a rounded hip; natural curved wrinkles cross the lower stomach. No exposed midriff or cleavage, no tattoos.
The camera is held high above and points down. Her entire face is visible near the upper-left, with BOTH eyes, nose, mouth and chin inside the image; only the crown is clipped. The head leans mildly toward the camera. Her torso slopes gently toward the lower-right, with the waist and rounded hip toward the bottom-right. This is a mild diagonal frame, roughly ten degrees, not a sideways rotated photo. The raised camera arm extends to image-right in a red sleeve. She looks up with a small closed smile. Dark fringe, cheek-length straight sections, ponytails, dark eyeliner and pink lips, a white earbud. Her free hand at lower-left holds a pale pink insulated mug with a broad metal rim. Light cupboard doors behind, warm wooden floor below, black rounded chair at left. Soft indoor light and a little motion softness and phone grain, relaxed everyday snapshot.
